symbols.name: transform layout
symbols.meaning: The permutation of record addresses that gathers the selected bits into chunks at a common offset.
symbols.quote: The transform layout is an explicit [permutation](permutation.md) $\mathcal{L}$ of record addresses.

relations.quote: The layout is built from [address-field interchange](address-interchange.md) moves of whole chunks, together with single-bit moves.
The transform layout prepares the input for each [simultaneous butterfly layer](simultaneous-butterfly-layer.md) of a transform round.

relations.predicate: is applied within each round of
relations.quote: The layout is applied within each round of the [synthetic polynomial transforms](synthetic-transforms.md).
The transform layout feeds its retained order to the [opposite transform](opposite-transform.md).
The transform layout is an explicit [permutation](permutation.md) $\mathcal{L}$ of record addresses.
The transform layout keeps each element of the [polynomial ring](polynomial-ring.md) that a record holds intact.
